combo1.title: Black Metal Fullmetal Bridge
combo1.description: A 1.5-card Black Metal Dragon line that converts early Striker Dragon access into the Red-Eyes metal package, then bridges through Borrelshroud and Fatalflare to finish on Borrelend Dragon, I:P Masquerena, Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon, and additional hand follow-up.

steps.text: Send to GY Black Metal Dragon
Add to Hand Boot Sector Launch
Add to Hand Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon
Special Summon Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon
Activate Effect Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon
Send to GY Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon
Send to GY Black Metal Dragon
Add to Hand Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon
Send to GY Boot Sector Launch
Send to GY Dragunity Knight - Romulus
Send to GY Black Metal Dragon
Add to Hand Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon
Activate Effect Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon
Activate Effect Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon
Special Summon Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon
Activate Effect Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon
Special Summon Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon
Send to GY Borreload Fatalflare Dragon

combo2.title: Loader Bystial Breachboard
combo2.description: A 1-card Rokket Loader starter that escalates through Dillingerous and Fatalflare into the Bystial package, ending on Borrelend Dragon backed by Bystial Dis Pater, Branded Beast, Borrel Reboot access, and extra Rokket extension. Two identical replay submissions confirmed this line, so the duplicate import was folded into this single entry.
